data.title: 陈千语 · 机械工坊的深夜微热
data.description: 机械零件与精密仪器整齐摆放的工坊内，只有工作台上的聚光灯散发着暖光。刚完成设备调试的陈千语拉开工装拉链，露出紧身无袖背心勾勒出的矫健挺拔曲线。她微微仰起头用毛巾擦拭脖颈处的细汗，乌黑瞳仁在光影下拉出明澈光泽，透着干练而迷人的私密张力。
data.location: late night mechanical workshop with cooling fan
data.action: unzipping work jacket over athletic tank top, resting against metal workbench, wiping neck with white towel, glistening perspiration on collarbone, earnest intense gaze
data.lighting: dramatic industrial spotlight focusing on workbench in dim workshop
data.mood: capable athletic intensity, magnetic private focus
data.promptProse: Resting against a metal workbench in a dimly lit workshop, Chen Qianyu unzips her outer jacket over a fitted tank top. Sweat glistens on her bare collarbones as she dabs her neck with a towel, gazing intently forward.
data.animaCaption: Chen Qianyu resting in a workshop in an unzipped jacket, wiping sweat from her neck.
